_what: Every word the private deal builder shows (contract-builder-screen.tsx), and the words the message uses where a value is not set yet (do-work/contract-builder-quote.mjs). A changed word is changed here, never in the screen's code.
title: Private deal
pursuit_pick: Choose the pursuit this deal is for.
pursuits_none: No pursuits are set up yet.
customer_search: Find a customer by name or email
products_none: This pursuit has no offers with prices yet.
lines_hint: Every line can be changed here. Nothing is saved until the message is sent.
line_at_cost: Named, not added to the total
template_pick: Choose a message, then change its words.
subject: Subject
link_not_yet: the private link, made when the deal is sent
preview_note: This is the message as the customer will get it. Sending is not part of this step.
sender_missing: This pursuit has no sender set up, so the message cannot say who it is from.
read_failed: This pursuit did not read. Try again.
